# Experimental AuthZEN sources

The access-request tests and examples are based on the AuthZEN Access Request and
Approval Profile draft from the OpenID AuthZEN repository.

- Repository: https://github.com/openid/authzen
- Commit: 6ed00bad5daa8f6eef6f2aef1f124442beeb8382
- Source path: profiles/authzen-access-request-approval/authzen-access-request-approval-profile-1_0.md

No upstream JSON fixtures are copied into this repository for the first
single-item requester slice. Test payloads are local, reduced examples derived
from the pinned profile shape.
